* fix(load-gate): the charge checks judge the charge outside V8's young generation (brandon-frame-feed-znsy.zpm)

V8 sizes its young generation by allocation rate, up to a ceiling the Node
version sets, so the charge of one build steps between modes and a budget
between them judges V8's sizing, not the daemon. The daemon's stats report
the young generation's committed bytes; the gate subtracts it from each
sample's charge.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(load-gate): the budget judges the charge once V8 has collected, recalibrated (brandon-frame-feed-znsy.zpm)

The under-load charge of one build lands in either of two modes ~15 MB apart:
V8 sizes the garbage the old generation holds before collecting from measured

releases the watch and acquires the new key, and the refresh event says

construction, as the config cache's watch key already does.
